svg.title: FOX Studio. Protect.
svg.desc: Animated opening on a dark background. One word at a time in the centre, in hard cuts that get faster: the word protect in Portuguese (PROTEGER, in orange), English, French, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic and Hindi. The screen goes dark for a moment, and then only the FOX Studio fox-in-hexagon logo and the name FOX Studio remain.
